decisions.reason: As a distant, niche line with weaker visible commitment than the core ranges, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and have its resources redirected.
This line fits the industrial core business and received follow-on LED kit development, indicating results likely met aspiration levels and justify continued support.
The relaunched and previously popular task light is close to the established offer, so with current firm growth and organisational slack it is more likely to be retained.
A recent office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's workplace lighting strategy, and a large expanding firm would usually keep such a core-market product while performance becomes clearer.
The premium pendant range has several models and strong strategic fit with the firm's established business, making removal within a year relatively unlikely.
